501.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Pain

Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Mountain Lion Blood (10)

Description

Oh, <name>. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk. I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all. I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls. Help me, would you? My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion. Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.

Progress

I remember you, <name>.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.

Completion

Superb collecting, <name>.

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Gloves of Brawn Stomping Boots
Firewalker Boots Trophy Belt
You will also receive:
Recipe: Hot Lion Chops

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Undercity

/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(501))

502.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Pain

Feed the Elixir of Pain to Stanley.
Elixir of Pain (Provided) (1)

Description

Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain. If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."

Progress

Woof?

Completion

You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.

Gains

  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 75 reputation with Undercity

509.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Agony

Bring 6 Mudsnout Blossoms to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Mudsnout Blossoms (6)

Description

Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, <name>: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.

Progress

Any luck at Nethander Stead?

Completion

Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms.  At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.

Rewards

You will receive:
Swiftness Potion Healing Potion

Gains

  • Open in Experience Calculator

513.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Agony

Take the Mudsnout Composite to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Mudsnout Composite (Provided) (1)

Description

Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.

First I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!

Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, <name>.

Progress

Can you not see I am busy, <class>?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!

Completion

Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 50 reputation with Undercity

515.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Agony

Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Elixir, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Mudsnout Mixture (Provided) (1)
Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir (1)
Daggerspine Scale (5)
Torn Fin Eye (5)

Description

A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!

Progress

So glad to see you back, <name>.  I was growing so terribly bored here.  Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her. . .over and over and over again.

How went the trip to the Undercity?  Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?

Completion

The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy!  You have been such a great help, <name>.  Together we will spread death and disease to this land!

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
High Apothecary Cloak Meditative Sash
Glistening Stompers

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 150 reputation with Undercity

517.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Agony

Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Keg of Shindigger Stout (1)

Description

This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

Head down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, <name>.

Progress

Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air.  Makes Umpi a little nervous though.

So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves?  I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.

Completion

Finally!  Now we are ready for action!

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 50 reputation with Undercity

524.dialogueBodyHTML:
Elixir of Agony

Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.
Tainted Keg (Provided) (1)

Description

Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from Stormwind to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the Plaguelands last night. Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.

I think it's time we threw those farmers a party. Sounds like a grand ol' time!

Place this tainted keg on the rug in their room. Plagued brew for all!

Progress

A musty smell emanates from the rug.

Completion

You rest the tainted keg on the dusty rug.

216.ownTitle: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur
216.dialogueBodyHTML:
Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

Take down 12 Thistlefur Avengers and 12 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
  •  
Thistlefur Avenger slain (12)
  •  
Thistlefur Shaman slain (12)

Description

The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

<name>, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!

Progress

Have you taken the fight to the Thistlefur?  With a clear path between our bases, our chances of claiming the whole of Ashenvale increase dramatically.

Completion

Well done <class>, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!

Rewards

You will receive:

  • 100 reputation with Orgrimmar

6621.dialogueBodyHTML:
King of the Foulweald

Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.
Murgut's Totem (1)
Provided item:
Karang's Banner (1)

Description

<name>, another tribe of Furbolgs, the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar. They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat. With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound. They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe. Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, <name>. This is no task for a single <class>.

Progress

Did you defeat Chief Murgut, <name>?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?

Completion

Good work, <name>.  Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:

The Horde is not to be trifled with.

I don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Boorguard Tunic Cobalt Legguards
You will also receive:

25.dialogueBodyHTML:
Stonetalon Standstill

Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.

Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.

Return to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
  •  
Befouled Water Elemental slain (12)

 

Explore Zone (1)

 

Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost. (1)

Description

If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?

Progress

You back already?  What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?

Completion

Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.

Rewards

You will receive:

6441.dialogueBodyHTML:
Satyr Horns

Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.
Satyr Horns (16)

Description

Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.

Progress

I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, <name>. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!

Completion

These are perfect, <name>! Thanks for helping me out!

Oh, and this is for your time...

Rewards

You will receive:

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Ratchet

6571.dialogueBodyHTML:
Warsong Supplies

Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.
Warsong Saw Blades (1)
Warsong Axe Shipment (1)
Warsong Oil (1)
Logging Rope (1)

Description

We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?

Progress

I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!

Completion

Excellent, <name>. You've saved me a lot of work!

But don't think that I'm not grateful!

Rewards

Warsong Sash Warsong Boots
Warsong Gauntlets

Gains

6581.dialogueBodyHTML:

Progress

Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

1918.dialogueBodyHTML:
The Befouled Element

Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
Befouled Water Globe (Provided) (1)

Description

The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water. The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting. It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.

It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.

Progress

Yeah, what do you need?

Completion

You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me?  Who am I, the Earthen Ring or something?

Actually, that does give me an idea... perhaps you do need the Earthen Ring for this.  I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.

You know who the Earthen Ring are, <name>?

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 25 reputation with Orgrimmar

8: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

824.dialogueBodyHTML:
Je'neu of the Earthen Ring

Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Befouled Water Globe (Provided) (1)

Description

The Earthen Ring is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.

Lucky for you, I know someone in the Earthen Ring here in Ashenvale. Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.

Progress

Ah, hello there.  I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.

Is there something I can help you with?

Completion

This globe... it is most disturbing.  Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices.  To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.

I will see that this globe is studied properly by the Earthen Ring.  Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements.  Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the Earthen Ring.

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Deftkin Belt Driftmire Shield
Soft Willow Cape

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Darkspear Trolls
